I got braces with Dr. Hong. She's very kind. She'll keep us informed about the steps and what will be done. She'll always tell us what the plan is and ask us what we want and if we're satisfied with it. She's straightforward and doesn't prolong the treatment. This is the only clinic that can tell us how long it will take to straighten our teeth. She'll clearly answer all the expenses. This is my second time getting braces because my retainer is gone and my wisdom teeth are coming in. I also had my wisdom teeth removed here with Dr. Hui. The doctor is very skilled, has a gentle hand, and the swelling is minimal to none. The wound healed quickly (I strictly followed the doctor's advice). The price is cheap, but the quality is very good. I didn't make the right decision to come here. I also brought my mom to get dentures. My mom was very satisfied and happy. She said the doctor is good and pays attention to every detail. The dentures are beautiful and comfortable to wear. My boyfriend also had his teeth cleaned and checked here. The receptionists are very lovely. They're always kind and polite to us. 🥰 If you're looking for a quality clinic with affordable prices, from the doctor to the receptionists, clean, and cafe-style, I recommend this place. 👍🏼
